description: Header file for CWMP plugin, defining interfaces, data structures, and external dependencies for managing CWMP protocol operations in a network device.

classes.name: cwmp_plugin_app_t
classes.description: Structure holding the plugin's application state, including a data model pointer, parser, and initialization status.

classes.name: cwmp_proc_ctx_t
classes.description: Context structure for managing plugin processes, including callback functions and private data.

methods.name: _cwmp_plugin_main
methods.description: Main entry point for plugin operation, handling different reasons for invocation.

methods.name: cwmp_plugin_set_app
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with data model and parser.

methods.name: cwmp_plugin_get_dm
methods.description: Returns the current data model instance.

methods.name: cwmp_plugin_get_parser
methods.description: Returns the current parser instance.

methods.name: cwmp_plugin_get_config
methods.description: Returns plugin configuration variables.

methods.name: _ManagementServer_updateConnectionRequestURL
methods.description: Updates the connection request URL on the management server object.

methods.name: _ManagementServer_updateParameterKey
methods.description: Updates the parameter key on the management server object.

methods.name: _AddTransfer
methods.description: Adds a transfer operation.

methods.name: start_cwmpd
methods.description: Starts the CWMP daemon.

methods.name: stop_cwmpd
methods.description: Stops the CWMP daemon.

methods.name: isAddressIpV6
methods.description: Checks if an IP address is IPv6.

methods.name: cwmp_proc_ctx_new
methods.description: Creates a new process context with specified callbacks and private data.

methods.name: cwmp_plugin_getFaultString
methods.description: Returns a fault string corresponding to an error code.

methods.name: cwmp_plugin_xmpp_init
methods.description: Initializes XMPP connection for plugin.

methods.name: cwmp_plugin_dm_save
methods.description: Saves the current data model state.

methods.name: cwmp_plugin_init_done
methods.description: Checks if plugin initialization is complete.

methods.name: cwmp_plugin_cwmpd_start_avoided
methods.description: Checks if starting CWMP daemon was avoided.

methods.name: cwmp_plugin_netmodel_open_queries
methods.description: Opens network model queries on specified interface.

methods.name: cwmp_plugin_netmodel_close_queries
methods.description: Closes network model queries.

methods.name: cwmp_plugin_netmodel_init
methods.description: Initializes network model.

methods.name: cwmp_plugin_netmodel_find_ip
methods.description: Finds IP address in network model.

methods.name: cwmp_plugin_netmodel_cleanup
methods.description: Cleans up network model resources.

methods.name: open_cwmpd_listening_port
methods.description: Opens listening port for CWMP daemon.

methods.name: close_cwmpd_listening_port
methods.description: Closes listening port for CWMP daemon.
